evidence.observation: Predicate 1 requires that `gnd export ossie MODEL --out OUT` behaves exactly as today when no new flag is given (writing three files), but D2(a) proposes 'five files by default' with an opt-out flag.

concerns.recommendation: Condition Predicate 1 on D2(b) or update it to reflect the five-file default if D2(a) is chosen.
concerns.title: Completion Predicate 1 is unfalsifiable if D2(a) is ruled

evidence.observation: Section 2.3 states: '1:1 fact types are absorbed toward the mandatory side.' This rule is ambiguous and non-deterministic if both roles are mandatory or neither is mandatory.

concerns.recommendation: Provide a deterministic tie-breaker for 1:1 absorption when mandatory constraints are symmetrical.
concerns.title: Ambiguous Rmap rule for 1:1 fact type absorption

evidence.observation: Issue 3 requests the binding to supply 'columns (sql_type, targets, references), primary_key, roles and extension_roles'. OB4 C1 only requires 'a valid binding replaces datasets, fields, PKs and relationships', failing to own sql_type, targets, roles, and extension_roles.

concerns.recommendation: Update OB4 criteria to explicitly own the processing and mapping of sql_type, targets, roles, and extension_roles from the binding file.
concerns.title: Issue 3 requested physical binding properties are missing from OB4 criteria

evidence.observation: Section 2.3 requires listing 'Unrepresentable constructs (mandatory and NOT NULL, value constraints, frequency, ring, subset, exclusion, derivations, deontic rules)'. OB3 C3 only states 'every fact type is mapped or listed', omitting the unrepresentable constraints.

concerns.recommendation: Update OB3 criteria to explicitly verify the listing of all unrepresentable constructs, not just fact types.
concerns.title: Issue 2 requirement to list unrepresentable constructs is not fully owned by OB3

evidence.observation: Phase OB1 is marked as 'Ready: draft spec. Needs D3 only.' However, D3 determines the ceiling for the output bound and whether import gets a matching flag, meaning OB1 cannot be fully specified until D3 is ruled.

concerns.recommendation: Mark OB1 as blocked on D3 and refrain from finalizing its specification until the decision is ruled.
concerns.title: Phase OB1 is specified before its mandatory decision D3 is ruled

summary: Found blocking concerns regarding unfalsifiable predicates, ambiguous Rmap rules, and unowned requests from the source issues.
